title: Narrow chat column: trigger row fits, header controls stay in the column, clock hides while a question waits
steps: S1: Run the turn-trigger-row e2e of tracy-chat-input: dsh's trigger row with the plugin stylesheet in 300px and 250px columns, light and dark.
S2: Run the clock-while-waiting e2e of tracy-ask-form: a conversation with the pointer card and one without, then the card removed.
S3: Run the header-layout e2e of tracy-model-plan: the real dsh header with the site chip (short and long name), jobs, a Voice-sized utility and More, at 800 to 220px.
expect: S1: every piece of the row ends inside its padding, the title wraps only between words, the time shows at 300px and hides at 250px.
S2: the clock is not displayed in the conversation with the card, is displayed in the other, and comes back once the card goes.
S3: no header control ends past the header's right edge at any width; with a short name the model chip still truncates at 300px and hides only at 220px.
evidence: 21/10/2026 cowork.tracy.site g66-ess-wp-blank: trigger row time past its border at 300px; More actions gone from 270px; Thinking for 1m 33s while a question waited
fence: Tracy plugin CSS and the site chip's header-room measure, in Chromium against dsh's own CSS modules
